intro: Chok'sul's Head serves as gruesome physical proof of the death of the Mo'grosh ogre chieftain. Brought to Magistrate Bluntnose in Thelsamar, it secures a formal bounty placed by local dwarven authorities.

p: The ogres of Mo'grosh Stronghold pose a persistent menace to the settlements of Loch Modan, orchestrating assaults against Thelsamar, the excavation sites, and the vital Stonewrought Dam. Magistrate Bluntnose placed a bounty on the brute presumed to be coordinating these attacks: Chok'sul. Given the chaos of the northeastern hills, the magistrate demands undeniable evidence before releasing township funds. The severed head of the ogre chieftain provides the grotesque certainty the dwarven council needs to mark the contract fulfilled.
